Image: Kathrin Marks | Creative Commons Coromandel Forest Park Located in  the Coromandel region Base yourself at one of the campsites in the area and explore the numerous tracks with relics from kauri logging and gold mining eras. Visit Kauaeranga Valley , Broken Hills area or Wentworth Valley . Coromandel Forest Park can be accessed from SH25 near Thames (Kauaeranga Valley), Whangamata (Wentworth Valley) and Hikuai (Broken Hills).
